connection.evidence: User-controlled 'query' parameter flows directly into database filter conditions for username, first_name, and last_name fields

diff_causality.evidence: Adding last_name field expands search scope when 'fullname' parameter is present, materially increasing information disclosure surface

security_control.required_control: authorization to restrict user data access based on user roles/privileges
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-425 requires authorization controls to prevent unauthorized access to restricted resources
existing_controls_checked: webapi_check_login_required decorator provides authentication but no role-based authorization for user data access
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No evidence of authorization checks limiting which users can search/access other users' personal information

concrete_impact.evidence: Potential information disclosure of user names, but CWE-425 requires unauthorized access to restricted URLs/files, not just data exposure through authorized API endpoints

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the search would only match usernames when 'fullname' parameter is present, reducing the information disclosure surface by excluding personal name fields.
